answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. A new agent locks 100 units until it builds a fingerprint over 20 epochs of trades in saffron, sable, or relics, each deal peer-checked. 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 units locked 20 epochs plus 1,000 faked histories; one honest trader pays once and recovers the deposit with undiluted rewards. A rented fingerprint fails: escrow releases only to the original holder, so the borrower loses the deposit.
